تعتقلن (form VIII)
# تَعْتَقِلْنَ (taʕtaqilna) /taʕ.ta.qil.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# تُعْتَقَلْنَ (tuʕtaqalna) /tuʕ.ta.qal.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
